Build HappyView apps: a project directory, run and tested locally

Usage: hpy happyview [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  create    Scaffold a new HappyView project
  dev       Run the project with its pinned HappyView; a saved file is live on the next request
  add       Add plugins to happyview.toml and happyview.lock and download them; with none, bring the
            lock up to date and download it
  scaffold  Write a starter handler beside each query or procedure lexicon under src/ that has none
  build     Build every compiled script module in happyview.toml into .happyview/build/
  check     Build the project's snapshot without serving it; exits non-zero on any error
  test      Run the project's tests
  types     Write editor types for the project into .happyview/types/, and the tsconfig.json or
            .luarc.json that points editors at them
  login     Sign in to a HappyView instance through your browser, to deploy to it
  logout    Sign out of an instance
  whoami    Show the instances you are signed in to
  deploy    Make an instance match the project: its plugins from happyview.lock, then its lexicons,
            scripts and modules
  env       Work with the deployed instance's script variables, which scripts read as `ctx.env`
  pull      Build a project from what an instance serves: its lexicons, scripts, plugins and
            settings
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json      Print the result as JSON on stdout
      --no-input  Never prompt; fail when a value is missing. Irreversible actions still need --yes.
                  Implied without a terminal
  -C <DIR>        Run as if started in DIR
  -h, --help      Print help
